subject: math
cluster: Reason with shapes and their attributes

items.prompt:
Two squares side by side make a
A) rectangle
B) circle
C) triangle
D) cube

How many triangles make a square cut corner to corner?
A) $2$
B) $3$
C) $4$
D) $1$

A $2$ by $2$ block of small squares makes a
A) bigger square
B) triangle
C) circle
D) line

Two triangles joined on the long side make a
A) rectangle
B) circle
C) sphere
D) cube

Three squares in a row make a
A) rectangle
B) triangle
C) circle
D) cube

steps: A row of squares is a rectangle.

items.prompt:
Can smaller triangles make a bigger triangle?
A) Yes
B) No
C) Only squares
D) Only circles

steps: Triangles combine into a bigger one.

items.prompt:
How many small squares make a $2$ by $2$ bigger square?
A) $4$
B) $2$
C) $3$
D) $6$

How many small triangles can make one bigger triangle?
A) $4$
B) $0$
C) $1$
D) $7$

steps: $4$ small triangles make a bigger one.
